why: The double line moves clockwise from corner to corner: top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left, top-left, and it turns 90 degrees each time. The small shape also moves clockwise to the next corner: bottom-left, top-left, top-right, bottom-right, and the shapes are triangle, square, circle, star. So C has the double line at bottom-left and a circle at top-right: option 4. Option 3 has the right lines but a square instead of a circle.
trick: Corner-moving patterns usually go clockwise or anticlockwise one corner per step; follow both the lines and the small shape.
